notes.title: Major fixes to the ending!
notes.content:
[b]Ground control to our Steam fans![/b]

We fixed an issue with one of the endings for the game, now you'll be able to experience 100% of the story!

We've also found and fixed a few glitches, including one with the screens in the Himejo and Yuri route.

Thanks for your support and feedback!
